title: Length of a nested pair encoding
statement: For any bit strings $u$, $\alpha$, and $x$, the length of the encoding of $(u,\langle\alpha,x\rangle)$ is $2|u|+2|\alpha|+4+|x|$, where $|w|$ denotes the length of a bit string $w$.
